title: The Low Places
summaryZh: 當我們身處低谷時，可以效法詩人向神傾吐哀傷、與朋友分享，並將盼望交託給神。
lines: One of my favorite musicians, singer songwriter named Gregory Alan Isakov.
我最喜歡的音樂家之一，是一位名叫格雷戈里·艾倫·伊薩科夫的創作歌手。
He has a song called "Dark, Dark, Dark."
他有一首歌叫做《Dark, Dark, Dark》。
And there's a line in it where he says, "The songs in my pocket just crumble apart.
裡面有一句歌詞說：「我口袋裡的歌就這樣碎裂。
Won't you sing me something for the dark, dark, dark."
你能為這黑暗、黑暗、黑暗唱點什麼嗎？」
I love that line because it's not a matter of if you will go through dark seasons, it's a matter of when.
我很喜歡那句歌詞，因為我們是否會經歷黑暗的季節，不是會不會的問題，而是何時的問題。
And when you do there are certain songs that just can't hold the weight of your pain.
當你經歷時，有些歌就是無法承載你痛苦的重量。
What you need in those seasons is a song for the dark.
在那些季節裡，你需要的是一首為黑暗而唱的歌。
Psalm 42 is a song for the dark.
詩篇第42篇就是一首為黑暗而寫的歌。
"My tears have been my food day and night," the Psalmist writes.
詩人寫道：「我晝夜以眼淚當飲食。」
你曾經歷過那種境地嗎？
Maybe you're stumbling upon this video and you're there right now.
也許你偶然點開這部影片，而你現在正處於那種境地。
As a licensed counselor, I see people in these places all the time.
身為一名持照的諮商師，我總是看到人們處於這樣的低谷。
And as a human being living in this broken world, I've been in these places myself.
而作為生活在這個破碎世界裡的一個人，我自己也曾經歷過這些低谷。
What do we do when we're in the low places?
當我們處於低谷時該怎麼辦？
What do we do when the sadness seems like it might take over?
當悲傷似乎快要將我們吞噬時，我們該怎麼辦？
Well, what if, what if we did what the psalmist does?
那麼，如果，如果我們照著詩人所做的去做呢？
What does the psalmist do with his sadness?
詩人如何處理他的悲傷？
He laments it, he shares it and he entrusts it.
他哀哭，他分享，並把它交託。
Lament means to take all of the sadness, all the pain, all the doubt, all of it, and without holding back, pour it out in prayer.
哀哭意味著帶著所有的悲傷、所有的痛苦、所有的懷疑，所有的一切，毫無保留地在禱告中傾吐出來。
God, my soul, thirst for you.
我的眼淚成為我的飲食。
God, why have you forgotten me?
But he not only laments his sorrow, he shares it.
但他不僅為自己的悲哀哭泣，他還與人分享。
The inscription says Psalm 42 is a psalm of the Sons of Cora.
題注說詩篇第42篇是可拉後裔的訓誨詩。
They were like a musical group.
他們就像一個樂團一樣。
You see, the writer of this psalm didn't sing alone.
你看，這篇詩篇的作者不是獨自歌唱。
He had friends who joined him in his sadness.
他有朋友加入，與他分擔悲傷。
My hope is that you have a friend to share in your sadness.
我的盼望是，你也能有一位朋友來分擔你的悲傷。
但接著他將這一切交託。
"Hope in God, O my soul," he says.
他說：「我的心哪，應當仰望神。」
When we're feeling this kind of lowness, we look to the one who came low for us.
當我們感受到這種低谷時，我們要仰望那位為我們降卑的。
Came as low as a torturous death on a cross.
降卑到在十字架上受盡折磨而死的程度。
Came low to secure our hope, that whatever we're going through today, there is a day coming when sadness will be gone forever.
祂降卑是為了確保我們的盼望，也就是無論我們今天正在經歷什麼，終有一日，悲傷將永遠消失。
And that day has been secured by Jesus.
而那一天已經由耶穌為我們保證了。
Be honest with God because He is holding tightly to you.
對神誠實，因為祂正緊緊地抓住你。
